title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode3 Goals For The Year

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Morning, everyone.
You all seem to be enjoying yourselves this morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka! Minori!
Good wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do neither of you have work today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We have today and tomorrow off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, which classes are you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, thank you for asking!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, have finally fulfilled my dream of...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Being in the same class as Haruka!
It's finally happened!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, that shouldn't come as much of a surprise since the credit-based course doesn't have that many people in it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, but...!
You don't get it, Shiho!
Being in the same class as Haruka means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Being in the same classroom, breathing the same air and seeing what she's like during classes...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I get to live the dream as a student! This is nothing short of a miracle! And I'm putting that lightly...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, now I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You must be feeling so wonderhoy, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's the Minori we're used to hearing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I am glad that we didn't get separated, Minori. This should definitely make things easier whenever we have to miss class and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm happy that you'll be there with me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...!
No, your aura's blinding...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is turning into some sort of weird new skit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Sorry, I didn't mean to get carried away. I'm just so happy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm okay now!
I'm going to do my absolute best as Minori Hanasato the idol moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, am now a second-year in the credit-based course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to work lots and lots for MORE MORE JUMP! I know that things might be tougher than before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm gonna keep doing what I can to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Let's start heading over to the gym!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, the opening ceremony's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no, I wanted to go early since the entrance to the gym's gonna be super crowded right before the start time...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, we got really engrossed in our conversation. Let's start heading over, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's head back to our classroom for a second. Kohane should be back by now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
See you all later!
Outside the Gym

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, you're both in the same class again, Hinomori, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we had a pretty good feeling that we would be. We just can't get rid of each other no matter how hard we try.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're in Class B, right, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Me? Yes.
But how did you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Because your name's always towards the top. It's hard not to see it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see. That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still...
We're all in our final year now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It feels kinda weird to think we'll all have graduated in one year's time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we can't be getting lost in thought.
Minori and Haruka showed us their commitment by going credit-based, so we gotta keep doing our best and show them how it's done.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
We need to do what we can as their seniors in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You sound very motivated.
I'll need to do what I can to keep up with you two.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
Would you mind telling us about your goals?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? My goals?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to spend so much time thinking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A lot happened recently and...
I haven't had a chance to plan for the future.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you're ever in need of help, please feel free to let us know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know how much I can do for you, but shooting at the archery range together should help clear your mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We could even go out for some Japanese sweets like we did in Kyoto!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...
Shizuku, Airi, Asahina! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, good morning!
It's rare to see you all together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all in the same class?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes.
We're all in Class A.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Class A...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please try to be careful with the door to the broom closet. It doesn't fit in the frame right and someone got hurt last year trying to open it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That happened...?!
Thank you very much for letting us know, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get why you're being so formal with her, but don't forget the new kids are gonna be looking up to you guys too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll all become wonderful role models.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, please feel free to ask us if you ever find yourselves in trouble. I'd like to do my best as well, as your senior.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I feel a lot better knowing that you'll be there for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the opening ceremony's going to start soon. We should get in line.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!
